name: A New Chapter
note: end of an era / quick comeback story

words.label: BACK IN TIME FOR CHRISTMAS
words.body:
Scott’s will relaunch upstairs at *The Deer’s Head on Lower Garfield Street* with its annual *Big Christmas Bash* across 18, 19 & 20 December.

The move also brings the club closer to the heart of Belfast, with plans to return to its regular programme of *live jazz every Friday night*.
